name: staffpicked
description: StaffPicked builds collections and playlists on Emby and Jellyfin from MDBList lists, Trakt lists and your own Markdown lists, with artwork from TMDB, fanart.tv, MediUX or your own files, all kept in sync on a schedule from one web UI.

paths.name: App Configuration
paths.description: Settings, list files, artwork copies and backups.

paths.name: Artwork Folder
paths.description: Optional: a folder of your own posters and backdrops, so a list can point at /artwork/name.jpg.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the container runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the container runs as (100 = users on Unraid).
